test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B' means ‘A is the sister of B’,

'A - B' means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A × B' means ‘A is the mother of B'

and 'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the son of B’.

How is V related to T if 'S + T - U × V - W + X?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is

Given: S + T - U × V - W + X

S + T → S is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea6c020ae7bc450de163468b52ea19745fb514ad51ff12185139078ff4394880.png] 

T - U → T is the husband of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01231462de2c3b60fb97050fd5843bf90cfc12109967b3af26badbf6d4060399.png] 

U × V → U is the mother of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcf0ae5eed0a749134700c74ca078efbbe527d42b67caaf6a07c589d5adf167d.png] 

V - W → V is the husband of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/966b044e748582b819ed18a666900fb4ad8a0cf0d0f4c5d19de806128c47d195.png] 

W + X → W is the sister of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75eb041f7d0c02f068d5791c8c9f6f1bc3e81e6f91c9fc3ec00312ad418e810d.png] 

Thus, V is T's son.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
